key.name: stay-on-top
key.summary: Keep the window above other windows
key.description: Applied by the SysMo Gauges GNOME Shell extension, which must be enabled.

key.name: cooler-display
key.summary: Show CPU readings on a DeepCool cooler's display

key.name: cooler-fahrenheit
key.summary: Show °F instead of °C on the cooler's display

key.name: fan-profiles
key.description: Fan header (hwmon chip name and channel, for example "nct6799:2") to (held at a fixed speed, speed in percent). Fans not listed are left to the motherboard.

key.name: fan-auto-modes
key.description: Each fan header's pwm_enable value before SysMo took control; written back when SysMo hands the fan back.

key.name: fan-selected
key.summary: Fan shown in the cooler panel

key.name: network-share
key.summary: Share this computer's CPU and GPU load on the local network
key.description: Lets a SysMo showing the Network tab on another computer list this one. Off: SysMo ignores its "who's there?" messages.

key.name: network-ssh-hosts
key.summary: Computers without SysMo to watch over SSH
key.description: Addresses, ranges or subnets, for example "192.168.1.100-130" or "192.168.1.0/24". SysMo logs in with the user's SSH keys while the Network tab is open.

key.name: network-ssh-user
key.summary: User name for the SSH nodes
key.description: Empty uses whatever ssh would use (~/.ssh/config, or the local user name).

key.name: section-states
key.summary: Expanded or collapsed state of each section
key.description: Entries of the form "section-id:expanded" or "section-id:collapsed". Sections without an entry use their default state.
